description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against a canvas table staged by gnomad_list_gene_variants (table gene_variants) or gnomad_search_clinvar (table clinvar_variants) and return one page of the result. Use the canvas_id and table_name those tools returned to rank by allele frequency, group by consequence class, count loss-of-function variants, or filter the full set the inline preview only sampled. A page holds up to limit rows (default 100, max 500) and ends early once its rows reach 10,000 characters of JSON; continue from next_offset until it is null. Each page re-runs the SQL, so stable paging needs an ORDER BY over a unique key (such as variant_id) and an unchanged table. Paging reaches the server row cap: above it total is null and later rows are reachable only by filtering or aggregating in SQL. SELECT statements only — writes, DDL, and file/HTTP table functions are rejected by the canvas gate. Call gnomad_dataframe_describe first to discover staged table and column names.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by gnomad_list_gene_variants or gnomad_search_clinvar.

limit.description: Maximum rows on the page (1–500). A page also ends before its rows pass 10,000 characters of JSON.

offset.description: Row offset of the page to return. Start at 0, then pass next_offset from the previous page.

sql.description: Read-only SQL SELECT. Reference tables by the names the staging tool returned (e.g. gene_variants). Add an ORDER BY over a unique key when paging.

name: gnomad_dataframe_query

columns.description: Column names in the result, in order.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: DataCanvas is not enabled on this server instance. `row_too_large`: The first row of the requested page serializes to more than 10,000 characters of JSON, so no page can hold it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: offset for the next page; null when no page follows (end of the result, or the row cap reached).

offset.description: Row offset this page starts at.

returned.description: Rows on this page — fewer than limit when the 10,000-character row budget or the end of the result ends it early.

rows.description: This page of result rows, in result order.

items.description: One result row — dynamic columns per the SQL projection.

total.description: Rows the SQL produced; null when the result exceeds the server row cap, whose later rows paging cannot reach.

truncated.description: True when result rows exist after this page, including rows past the row cap that next_offset cannot reach.

title: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server: dataframe query
